impact: Most of Monday's Huang bounce in MU, DRAM and SNXX is gone, and Korea's slide weighs on SKM's home market; Dell's record AI backlog is the offset, with PCE and the tariff decision as the next swing factors.
summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 7.9% on Tuesday to about 8,832, giving back 64% of Monday's gain. Micron dropped 11.0% to $629.79, with Texas Instruments down 11.2%, SanDisk 11.1%, Marvell 9.1%, AMD 8.9% and Western Digital 7.8%; Nvidia's loss is reported at 5.9% to 7.2%, and SK Hynix's ADRs fell 9.9%. On Wednesday the Kospi fell 5.54% to 4,728.81 by 11:20 a.m. Seoul time and was down close to 6% near 4,710 by mid-afternoon, after a sell-side sidecar halted program selling; Samsung was down about 9% and SK Hynix about 8.6% at 11:20 a.m. The Nikkei fell more than 3%. Traders cited an overdone rally, tariff and Middle East caution, and PCE data.
title: Micron falls 11%, chip index down 7.9%; Kospi slides nearly 6% Wednesday
